description: Write msPKI-Certificate-Name-Flag on a template, enabling enrollee-supplies-subject (ESC1 posture).

telemetry.detail: Template msPKI-Certificate-Name-Flag modification under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
Certificate request logged on the CA.
PKINIT TGT request with the issued certificate.

prerequisite_privilege: WriteProperty on the template's name flag (or GenericWrite/GenericAll)
abuse_primitive: Enable ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT, then enroll with an alternate SAN (ESC1).
notes: Turns a template into an ESC1 target; feeds ESC4. Same auditing caveat.
